CSIRO Mouse Surveillance

Spring-2017 Seasonal Summary

Published

April 24, 2026

Overview

This report summarizes house mouse monitoring activities conducted during the Spring-2017 season across Australian grain-growing regions. Mouse abundance was assessed using three complementary survey methods: live-trapping at benchmark sites, and rapid assessments using chew cards and active burrow counts.

Live-trap Surveys: A total of 597 trap nights (1 trap night = 1 trap set for 1 night) were conducted across 2 benchmark sites in 2 regions spanning 2 states (survey period: September 2017 to September 2017). These surveys captured 60 individual house mice, allowing abundance estimates at these monitoring locations.

Rapid Assessment Surveys: Rapid assessments were conducted across 8 regions using two methods. Chew card surveys deployed 587 cards across 51 sites, with 34.6% showing evidence of mouse activity (203 cards chewed). Active burrow surveys searched 197 transects across 44 sites (survey period: September 2017 to October 2017), detecting active burrows in 11.2% of transects (total: 79 active burrows).
